title: Individual part plate: one physical piece, one wearer-axis view
description: One physical piece (a left OR a right member of a pair, never both) seen from one camera defined on the WEARER's axes, on solid magenta for the deterministic matte (lampway_image_matte).

body.subject: The first image is the authoritative {{piece}} design. One physical piece only: the {{side}} {{piece}}, as worn
body.action: Keep its worn orientation, proportions, material, ornament, fastenings and wear exactly as in the first image; when the piece is one of a pair, this is that member itself, never a mirrored copy of the other side (buckles, reliefs and wear can differ by side). Any later image is a supporting anchor view of the same piece
body.camera: One view. Camera: {{view}}. Square frame, the piece centred with clear margins; scale: {{scale}}
body.style: Pure solid #FF00FF background edge to edge, orthographic projection, flat even diffuse lighting from the camera direction, matte materials, minimal specular
body.constraints: No second piece, body, hands, props, text, labels, captions or watermark

piece.description: the item, e.g. bracer, greave, sandal, pauldron

side.description: which physical member (the WEARER's side); single for an unpaired item

view.default: FRONT: directly in front of the wearer, looking toward the chest; the wearer's right appears image-left
enum: FRONT: directly in front of the wearer, looking toward the chest; the wearer's right appears image-left
RIGHT: from the wearer's own right; forward points image-right
BACK: directly behind the wearer; the wearer's right appears image-right
LEFT: from the wearer's own left; forward points image-left
TOP: directly above, looking straight down; a true overhead, not an elevated front
BOTTOM: directly below, looking straight up; the true underside, not a low three-quarter
view.description: the camera, defined on the wearer's axes even when the body is absent

enum: the anchor plate's physical scale (its longest elevation), so a short or end-on projection leaves more empty space
scale.description: independent framing, or one physical scale across a set (anchored to the longest elevation)

negatives: no cast or contact shadows, floor or ground plane
no gradient, vignette, rim light or transparency pattern
no oblique angle substituted for the stated view
no pair or second copy in the frame

reference_image.description: the design authority for this piece (the newest approved rendering)

image_references.description: an approved anchor view of the SAME piece (scale and detail); supporting only

openai/gpt-image*.note: GPT Image wants the reference order stated in prose and takes an explicit size (<= 3840 per edge, ~8.3 MP)

black-forest-labs/*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

google/gemini*.note: takes resolution + aspect_ratio; tolerates shorter prompts

sourceful/*.note: Riverflow: flattest albedo; takes resolution + aspect_ratio

gates.description: measure the border ring (lampway_image_matte verify): the generated magenta is never exactly #FF00FF
inspect the camera direction and the side: a filename cannot prove either
